title: A Holiday Brochure
text:
Maria found a brochure at the travel agency. The front of the brochure has a photo of a beach and the words 'Summer Holiday in Lisbon'. It is written in simple English and it has many pictures. The brochure is free, so you can take it home.

Inside the brochure, there is a map of the city and a list of hotels. Each hotel has a short description and a price per night. The last page shows how to book a room by phone or on the internet. Maria decided to call the hotel by the sea.

questions.text: Where did Maria find the brochure?

options: A map of the city and a list of hotels
A map of the country and a list of airports
A photo of a ship and a list of boats
A menu and a list of shops

questions.text: Why is the brochure useful for Maria?
options: It helps her plan a holiday
It helps her learn to cook
It helps her fix her car

questions.text: What can you infer from the words 'written in simple English'?
options: It can be easy to read for beginners
It is only for English teachers
It is too difficult for most people

vocabulary.definition: a small printed booklet with pictures and information, often about a place or a service
words that explain what something is like
a drawing that shows the streets and places of a city or country
to arrange in advance to use a room, seat or service

paragraph_translations: Maria encontrou um folheto em uma agência de viagens. A frente do folheto tem uma foto de uma praia e as palavras 'Férias de Verão em Lisboa'. Ele está escrito em inglês simples e tem muitas imagens. O folheto é grátis, então você pode levá-lo para casa.

Dentro do folheto, há um mapa da cidade e uma lista de hotéis. Cada hotel tem uma descrição curta e um preço por noite. A última página mostra como reservar um quarto por telefone ou pela internet. Maria decidiu ligar para o hotel à beira-mar.
